contract: OsdThread::current returns pthread_self cast to usize on Unix, not a kernel thread ID or Rust ThreadId. Repeated calls on one live thread return the same value.
fixture: A child reports two current identifiers while held alive by a channel. The parent reads its std::os::unix::thread::JoinHandleExt::as_pthread_t identifier, releases and joins the child, then compares both reported values. This uses a standard-library handle as the independent oracle and adds no unsafe code.
candidate: The existing pinned nix 0.31.3 dependency exposes sys::pthread::pthread_self behind its pthread feature. Inspected registry source src/sys/pthread.rs defines Pthread as libc::pthread_t and forwards directly to libc::pthread_self, with no conversion, allocation or errno handling. Enabling this feature adds no package; dependency audits passed.
deletion: Replaced the direct pthread_self unsafe block after baseline verification, preserving the native type, cast and public API. No parallel production path remains.
excluded: Windows identifiers and all other thread operations are unchanged. sysconf is a separate investigation: nix clears errno and exposes the online-processor option only on Linux/Android.
remaining: Verify replacement native evidence and final PR checks before integration
